name: 75662 · Kilgore, TX
findings: ZIP 75662 (Kilgore) has 76 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (55% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 75662 (Kilgore) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 11 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
